description: Update admin dashboard (admin.php) and admin actions (admin-action.php) to display, search, export, view, and edit all new fields. Also update success.php.
steps: Update admin.php CSV export to include all new columns in the SELECT and fputcsv output with appropriate headers
Update admin.php search query ($where clause) to also search head_teacher_name, head_teacher_phone, eiin_number, school_phone in addition to existing search fields
Update admin.php metrics section: add metric cards for the new institution types (technical, college, dakhil_madrasah, alim_madrasah) with quota display

Update admin.php table: keep it manageable - show school_name, type, union_name, subdomain, head_teacher_phone (or owner_phone), created_at, actions. The table does not need to show every field - that is what the View action is for

Update admin-action.php VIEW section to display ALL new fields organized in clear sections: Institution Details, Head Teacher/Contact, Address, Infrastructure, Student Statistics, Teacher Statistics, Technology Readiness, Domain & Vision

Update admin-action.php EDIT form to include input fields for ALL new columns, organized in sections matching the view. Use the same $v() helper pattern for old-input fallback. All new fields should be editable.
Update admin-action.php UPDATE validation to validate all new fields (same rules as submit.php but admin can leave optional fields blank to clear them)
Update admin-action.php UPDATE SQL to include all new columns in the UPDATE SET clause
Update admin-action.php institution_type select to use institution_types() helper for the full list
Update success.php to show a richer confirmation: include head teacher name, institution type label, union, and the proposed subdomain
acceptance_criteria: php -l admin.php passes without syntax errors
php -l admin-action.php passes without syntax errors
php -l success.php passes without syntax errors
CSV export includes all new field columns
Admin view shows all fields organized in clear sections
Admin edit form includes all new fields with proper input types
Admin update validation mirrors submit.php rules for new fields
No NID field appears anywhere in admin views or forms
findings: All files pass syntax checks. WhatsApp field (head_teacher_whatsapp) included in view, edit, CSV export, and update validation. No NID field anywhere. Admin CSV exports 60 columns matching the spec. View section organized into 7 sections with h3 headers. Edit form has all new fields with proper input types. Update validation mirrors submit.php rules (lenient for admin). Metrics grid shows all 7 institution types. Filter dropdown uses institution_types() dynamically. Search expanded to include head_teacher_name, head_teacher_phone, eiin_number, school_phone. success.php shows head teacher name, institution type, union, and subdomain. submit.php session data updated to pass extra fields.
